description: A React Native component for sharing and editing notes within the Notesnook app, including handling shared data, previewing links, managing attachments, and saving notes.

classes.name: ShareView
classes.description: Main React component for sharing notes, handling shared data, previewing links, managing attachments, and saving notes.

classes.name: AppendNote
classes.description: Component for displaying information about appending to an existing note.

methods.name: showLinkPreview
methods.description: Fetches link preview data and updates note title and content accordingly.

methods.name: sanitizeHtml
methods.description: Fetches and sanitizes HTML content from a URL.

methods.name: makeHtmlFromUrl
methods.description: Creates an HTML anchor tag from a URL.

methods.name: makeHtmlFromPlainText
methods.description: Converts plain text into HTML paragraphs.

methods.name: loadData
methods.description: Loads shared data, initializes note content, and handles attachments.

methods.name: onPress
methods.description: Handles saving the note, including appending to existing notes and uploading attachments.

methods.name: changeMode
methods.description: Switches between different clip modes (plain text, web clip, link) and updates content accordingly.

methods.name: onLoadEditor
methods.description: Marks the share extension as opened and loads data into the editor.

methods.name: onRemoveFile
methods.description: Removes an attached file and deletes it from the filesystem.
